title: Default All Panels to Hidden or Folded
description:
All panels must be hidden or folded by default. This includes:
1. Side panels (left/right) in playground layouts
2. Window options/measures panel in windows (cad play etc.)
3. Tree sections and items within panels
4. Collapsible groups within the window measures panel

Files to change:
- framework/core/index.ts: PRODUCT_SHELL_DEFAULT_PANEL_VISIBILITY both false
- ui/react/index.tsx: measuresFolded initial state → true; TreeSection/TreeItem/TreeProperty defaultOpen → false; section.defaultOpen ?? false; WindowMeasureTreeGroup defaultOpen → false
- cad/js/renderer/play/index.tsx: all defaultOpen: true → false
- puzzle/3d/play/index.ts: all defaultOpen: true → false
- puzzle/5d/play/index.ts: all defaultOpen: true → false
- flow/play/index.ts: all defaultOpen: true → false
- procedural/play/index.ts: all defaultOpen: true → false
- gis/map/play/index.ts: all defaultOpen: true → false
- reasoning/mindmap/wires/play/index.ts: all defaultOpen: true → false
